title: MQ SSL channel fails after certificate renewal - CipherSpec mismatch
description: After renewing SSL certificates on both the sender and receiver MQ servers last week, the SSL-encrypted channel between the two queue managers is failing with AMQ9641 CipherSpec did not match. Channel worked fine before the certificate renewal.

worklogs.description: Checked CipherSpec settings on both channels. Sender channel has TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256, receiver has TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA.
During certificate renewal, the receiver channel CipherSpec was inadvertently changed by the admin. Reverted to TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256 on both ends.
Started channel - connected successfully. Verified encrypted message transmission.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I checked the CipherSpec configuration on both channel ends. The sender channel is configured for TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256 but the receiver was changed to TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA during the certificate renewal process - the two must match. I will revert the receiver to TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: CipherSpec aligned on both ends. I have started the channel and it connected successfully. Could you verify that messages are flowing correctly through this channel?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Checked the receiving system - messages that were queued are now arriving. Channel is working. Thank you.

resolutionNote: CipherSpec was inadvertently changed on the receiver channel during the certificate renewal process. Sender was using TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256, receiver was changed to TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA. Aligned both to TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256.

csat.comment: Quick fix once the cause was identified.
